page.layout: One page of text in a single column at the top left, with the running head and page number above it. Below the text, centred, a woodcut fleuron. No margin notes.

main_text.l: sitas[?] scire cupit, is diligenter non solum Juriscon-
sultorum Germanicos libros, sed etiam Reverendis-
simi Domini Doctoris Martini Lutheri teutonica
Welcher lesen wil, weitlauffiger gebotte / der be-
sehe die Teutsche Sprachekunst Johannis Clajs
Hirtzbergensis / zu Leipzig von Johanne Rhamba getruckt. Wer aber herrliche
Teutsche weisen zure-den / auff Canzelen gebräuchlich / zu wissen begeret
/ der muß fleissig nicht allein der Rechtsgelerten Teutsche bücher /
sondern auch des Ehr-würdigen Herrn Doc. Marti-

page.notes: The fleuron below the text is an ornament (woodcut), not printed text, and is not transcribed. The first word of the page, "sitas", is a fragment continuing from the previous page; the first letter is uncertain (it resembles a long s with a rising stroke), so it is marked [?]. The word "weitlauffiger" is read from the scan with some doubt, and the hyphenation "zure-den" is a line-end break of "zu reden" as printed. The short centred lines at the end of the paragraph are set centred in the print but are running text, so they are kept in one paragraph.
